headline.purpose: Deck title, settings sheet title, empty-state heading.

title.purpose: Engraved pad label and settings section heads.

label.purpose: Inspector labels, bus names, status strip, hints; sentence case.

wordmark.purpose: Product name only; the one tracked, heavy setting.

data.purpose: Every number, time, slot, dB value and path, tabular.

keycap.purpose: Hotkey keycaps, numpad slots, bank letters.

shadows.name: key-travel
shadows.purpose: Pads only: lit top edge and 2px skirt that collapses when the key is pressed (translateY 2px).

shadows.name: toast
shadows.purpose: Toasts floating above the status strip.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Settings sheet sliding in from the right.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for every state change and entrance.

motion.name: dur-micro
motion.purpose: Hover, press, LED and colour changes.

motion.name: dur-short
motion.purpose: Chip rise, menu and palette pop, switch knob.

components.name: Button
components.description: Default panel-switch button on raised graphite.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-paper-3); color: var(--color-ink); font: 500 0.8125rem/1.4 var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--color-paper-4); border-color: var(--color-faint); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); background: var(--color-paper-2); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action; ink, never amber. Fills with ink on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M8 3v10M3 8h10"/></svg>Add sounds</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-muted); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-paper-4); color: var(--color-ink); font: 500 0.8125rem/1.4 var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-ink); border-color: var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-paper); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Toolbar and secondary actions without fill or outline.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted); font: 500 0.8125rem/1.4 var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-paper-4); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Recessed well input; amber border on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--color-well); color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 0.875rem/1.4 var(--font-body); transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-field:hover { border-color: var(--color-rule-strong); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-focus); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-focus); } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--color-faint); }

components.name: Keycap
components.description: Hotkey keycap in narrow mono with a 2px bottom edge.
components.css: .ds-kbd { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 18px; padding: 0 5px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong); border-bottom-width: 2px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--color-paper-2); color: var(--color-muted); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-stretch: 87.5%; font-size: 0.625rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Pad
components.description: The signature hardware key: status row on top, engraved label at the bottom, 2px key travel, amber outline and progress while playing.
components.css: .ds-pad { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto; width: 180px; height: 76px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-paper-3); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--color-rule-strong) inset, 0 2px 0 var(--color-well); color: var(--color-ink); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden; font-family: var(--font-body); transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-pad:hover { background: var(--color-paper-4); } .ds-pad:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--color-rule-strong) inset, 0 0 0 var(--color-well); background: var(--color-paper-2); } .ds-pad:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pad.ds-playing { border-color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-pad-status { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 20px; color: var(--color-neutral); font-size: 0.6875rem; } .ds-grow { flex: 1; } .ds-num { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-stretch: 87.5%; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-pip { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--led); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-rule-strong); } .ds-playing .ds-pip { box-shadow: none; outline: 1px solid var(--led); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-pad-kbd { height: 18px; padding: 0 5px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong); border-bottom-width: 2px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--color-paper-2); color: var(--color-muted); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-stretch: 87.5%; font-size: 0.625rem; } .ds-pad-name { grid-row: 3; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-progress { position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 42%; height: 2px; background: var(--color-accent); }

components.name: Bank Rail Item
components.description: Rail row for a bank: lettered plate and square LED, both amber when active.
components.css: .ds-rail-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 200px; height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted); font: 400 0.875rem/1.4 var(--font-body); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: var(--color-paper-3); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-rail-item.ds-active { background: var(--color-paper-4); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-label { flex: 1; } .ds-bank-letter { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 20px; height: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong); border-radius: 3px; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-active .ds-bank-letter { border-color: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-bank-led { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-paper-5); } .ds-active .ds-bank-led { background: var(--color-accent); }

components.name: Now-playing Chip
components.description: Status-strip chip for a playing clip with LED pip and stop button.
components.html: Crowd cheer
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 24px; max-width: 200px; padding: 0 2px 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--color-paper-3); color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 0.75rem/1.4 var(--font-body); } .ds-chip-pip { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--led); } .ds-chip-stop { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-neutral); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-stop:hover { background: var(--color-paper-5); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-chip-stop:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Sonic Dominion is a piece of pro-audio hardware rendered in a window. Pads are physical keys with a status row on top (LED pip, numpad slot, length, keycap) and an engraved label at the bottom; banks carry hardware letters with their own LED; numbers, times and keys are set in a narrow monospace like silkscreen on a faceplate. The window is dense and exact, built for a person who sets the board up between sessions and then fires it blind from hotkeys while a game has focus.

The material is warm graphite: one hue (60) stepped in lightness, with 1px rules doing the structural work. Colour is restrained to a single signal amber that means "live" and nothing else, plus eight low-chroma LED hues that belong to the user's content. Power shows in details (key travel, LED states, tabular numerals, a meter under each fader), never in decoration. The generic card-grid dashboard is the explicit anti-reference.
keyCharacteristics: Warm graphite surfaces, five elevation steps about 3.5% lightness apart.
One amber accent, reserved for live and active state.
Grotesk for the interface, narrow Martian Mono for data and keys only.
1px rules and tonal steps for structure; soft shadow only on floating overlays.
Small, square-ish corners (4/6/10px); LEDs are 2px-radius squares.
Pads behave like keys: a 2px travel on press.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber means live or active. At rest, with nothing playing or focused, the only amber on screen is the active bank's LED and letter; the wordmark LED and meters light only while audio is running.

rules.name: The User's Colour Rule
rules.body: LED hues are the user's content, not the interface's palette. They never tint a surface, a border, a button or text.

rules.name: The Ink Primary Rule
rules.body: The primary action is ink, never amber: it rests outlined in `muted` on `paper-4` and fills with ink on hover.

rules.name: The Silkscreen Rule
rules.body: Mono is for data and keys only. If a string would change when a clip, key or level changes, it is mono; if it is a word, it is grotesk.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every live number uses tabular figures so meters, timers and counts never shift width.

rules.name: The Flat Instrument Rule
rules.body: Regions are flat and ruled. A shadow means either "this is a key you press" or "this floats above the board". No glow, no glass, no blur.

dos: Do step surfaces by lightness on hue 60 (`paper` to `paper-5`) and separate regions with 1px `rule`.
Do reserve amber for playing, active bank, focus, listening and checked states.
Do set every number, time, slot and key in Martian Mono at 87.5% width with tabular figures.
Do build new pads and key-like controls with the status-row-on-top, label-at-bottom anatomy and 2px key travel.
Do draw LEDs as 8px (pads) or 6px (banks) squares with 2px corners.
Do keep corners on the 4/6/10px scale.
donts: Don't make the primary action amber; primary is ink.
Don't use LED hues on surfaces, borders, buttons or text.
Don't add glow, glassmorphism or blur, or decorative gradients; hard-stop gradients that draw a select chevron or a fader fill are fine.
Don't float content regions with shadows; shadow is for keys and overlays only.
Don't set words in mono or set labels in tracked uppercase; only the wordmark is tracked.
Don't fall back to a generic card-grid dashboard look: pads are keys, not cards.
